entity.name: `string.replaceAll()`
entity.description: Replace all instances of a string.
entity.descriptionHtml: Replace all instances of a string.
entity.descriptionClean: Replace all instances of a string.

example.codeHighlighted: const s1 = "foo_bar_baz"; const s2 = s1.replaceAll('_', '-');

webFeature.description_html: The replaceAll() method of strings returns a new string where all matches of a pattern (a string or regular expression) have been substituted with a replacement string.
webFeature.name: String replaceAll()

entity.name: `string.matchAll()`
entity.description: Return an iterator of all results matching this string against a regular expression.
entity.descriptionHtml: Return an iterator of all results matching this string against a regular expression.
entity.descriptionClean: Return an iterator of all results matching this string against a regular expression.

example.codeHighlighted: const regexp = /t(e)(st(\d?))/g; const str = 'test1test2'; const array = [...str.matchAll(regexp)];

webFeature.description_html: The matchAll() method of strings matches a string against a regular expression and returns an iterator of all results, including capturing groups.
webFeature.name: String matchAll()

entity.name: Regexp Match Indices
entity.description: Store the start and end positions of each matched capture group.
entity.descriptionHtml: Store the start and end positions of each matched capture group.
entity.descriptionClean: Store the start and end positions of each matched capture group.

example.codeHighlighted: const str1 = "foo bar foo"; const regex1 = /foo/dg; console.log(regex1.exec(str1).indices[0]); // Output: Array [0, 2]
